item.title: TEAM iC on Location at NASHCAMP 2025
item.description: There’s something special about NASHCAMP—maybe it’s the way the gym lights up when campers hit the floor, or the friendships built between reps and learning new skills. TEAM iC joined NASHCAMP to train, cheer on, and connect with campers. From hands-on training to meet-and-greets, they brought the hype and heart all summer long.

item.title: Apply Today! Team iC 2026 | Inside Cheerleading
item.description: In each issue of Inside Cheerleading, we feature a special group of athletes who share their exciting journey through the world of competitive cheer. As the new year approaches, we are looking to solidify members for TEAM iC 2026!

item.title: GAME DAY SYNERGY! Football Saturdays in “The Shoe” with THE Ohio State Spirit Program
item.description: From Game Day traditions to raucous rivalries to what it means to be a Buckeye, join us for a day in the life of THE Ohio State Spirit Program during an epic football Saturday in ‘The Shoe!’ Join us in this sitdown with Spirit Program Director, Melissa McGhee!

item.title: Issue Preview: 2025 Volume 5 | Baltimore Ravens Cheerleaders & More!
item.description: Our Volume 5 edition of Inside Cheer stars the Baltimore Ravens Cheerleaders! This iconic professional program is ‘Raising The Bar’ by redefining what’s possible after All Star and College Cheer. Join us in this exclusive interview with the Director of the Baltimore Ravens Cheerleaders, Tina Galdieri, and her incredible veteran athletes who discuss topics ranging from — how to transition into the professional football team realm, being an ambassador across the NFL, tryout tips, and SO MUCH MORE!
